```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# Source the extension entry point.
# Supports both GitHub install (thomashusson29/) and local checkout (auto-dark/).
auto_dark_setup <- c(
  "../_extensions/thomashusson29/auto-dark/auto-dark-setup.R",
  "../_extensions/auto-dark/auto-dark-setup.R"
)
auto_dark_setup <- auto_dark_setup[file.exists(auto_dark_setup)]
if (!length(auto_dark_setup)) {
  stop(
    "Cannot find auto-dark-setup.R. ",
    "Run `quarto add thomashusson29/quarto_auto_dark_theme` first, ",
    "or set the path manually."
  )
}
source(auto_dark_setup[[1]])
auto_dark_on()

library(ggplot2)
library(gt)
if (requireNamespace("gtsummary", quietly = TRUE)) library(gtsummary)
```

---

## Test 1 — ggplot2 plot

*Expected: transparent plot background; One Dark page colour visible behind panel.*

```{r}
#| label: fig-ggplot2
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| fig-cap: "ggplot2 scatter plot with theme_minimal(). Background must be transparent."
ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg, colour = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    x      = "Weight (1000 lbs)",
    y      = "Miles per gallon",
    colour = "Cylinders"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

---

## Test 2 — Base R plot

*Expected: transparent background; white plot elements inverted in dark companion.*

```{r}
#| label: fig-base-r
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-cap: "Base R plot. Axis, labels, and data points should be legible in both modes."
plot(
  mtcars$wt, mtcars$mpg,
  pch  = 19,
  col  = "#2A6F97",
  xlab = "Weight",
  ylab = "Miles per gallon",
  main = "Base R — mtcars"
)
abline(lm(mpg ~ wt, data = mtcars), col = "#e06c75", lwd = 2)
```

---

## Test 3 — Transparent background over One Dark page

*Expected: the plot panel area shows the page background (`#282c34`) in dark mode,
not white or grey.*

```{r}
#| label: fig-transparent
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 3.5
#| fig-cap: "Transparent device background test. Page colour must show behind the axes."
op <- par(bg = "transparent", mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))
curve(
  sin(x), from = -pi, to = 2 * pi,
  col  = "#61afef",
  lwd  = 2,
  xlab = "x",
  ylab = "sin(x)",
  main = "Transparent background test"
)
abline(h = 0, col = "#3e4451", lty = 2)
par(op)
```

---

## Test 4 — gt table

*Expected: table readable in both modes; dark background, light text in dark mode.*

```{r}
#| label: tbl-gt
#| tbl-cap: "A simple gt table using mtcars."
head(mtcars[, c("mpg", "cyl", "wt", "am")], 8) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "mtcars sample", subtitle = "First 8 rows")
```

---

## Test 5 — gtsummary table

*Expected: gtsummary table rendered as gt; same dark styling as Test 4.*

```{r}
#| label: tbl-gtsummary
#| tbl-cap: "A gtsummary table. Requires the gtsummary package."
if (requireNamespace("gtsummary", quietly = TRUE)) {
  gtsummary::trial |>
    dplyr::select(age, grade, trt) |>
    gtsummary::tbl_summary(by = trt, missing = "no") |>
    gtsummary::add_p() |>
    gtsummary::as_gt()
} else {
  cat("gtsummary not installed — skipped.")
}
```

---

## Test 6 — Local image via include_graphics

*Expected: a dark companion (`*-auto-dark.png`) is generated next to the file; it is
displayed in dark mode.*

```{r}
#| label: make-local-png
#| include: false
dir.create("generated", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
local_img <- "generated/test-local-image.png"

png(local_img, width = 700, height = 300, res = 100, bg = "white")
par(mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))
plot(pressure, type = "b", pch = 19, col = "#2A6F97",
     xlab = "Temperature", ylab = "Pressure",
     main = "Local PNG — include_graphics() test")
grid(col = "#dddddd")
dev.off()
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-include-graphics
#| out-width: "65%"
#| fig-cap: "Local PNG inserted with knitr::include_graphics(). Dark companion generated automatically."
knitr::include_graphics(local_img)
```

---

## Test 7 — Code block

*Expected: panel background `#21252b`; text `#e6edf3`; no overflow or white background.*

```{r}
#| label: code-block-test
#| echo: true
# This block should render with One Dark code block styling in dark mode.
x <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 100)
y <- sin(x) * exp(-x / 5)
head(round(data.frame(x = x, y = y), 3), 5)
```

## Test 8 — Callout

*Expected: callout background `#21252b`; border `#3e4451`; text legible.*

::: {.callout-note}
## Callout note

This is a Quarto callout. In dark mode it should have the One Dark panel background
(`#21252b`) and a visible border. Text should be `#abb2bf` or `#e6edf3`.
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
## Callout warning

A warning callout. The coloured left border should still be visible in dark mode.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## Callout tip

A tip callout. Verify that the icon and text are legible.
:::

*Expected: table border `#3e4451`; text `#abb2bf`; header distinguishable.*

| Test item             | Expected in dark mode         | Status |
|-----------------------|-------------------------------|--------|
| Page background       | `#282c34`                     | ☐      |
| Plot background       | Transparent                   | ☐      |
| ggplot2               | Dark companion shown          | ☐      |
| base R                | Dark companion shown          | ☐      |
| gt table              | Dark bg, light text           | ☐      |
| gtsummary table       | Same as gt                    | ☐      |
| include_graphics      | Dark companion shown          | ☐      |
| Code block            | One Dark panel bg             | ☐      |
| Callout               | One Dark panel bg + border    | ☐      |
| Light/dark toggle     | Works; persists in reload     | ☐      |
| OS dark mode          | Page starts dark automatically| ☐      |

## Test 10 — HTML document (this document itself)

*The HTML document format is `auto-dark-html`. The page background must be
`#282c34` in dark mode, and the light/dark switch in the Quarto header should
toggle correctly.*

> Verify with the switch in the top-right corner (or set your OS to dark mode and
> reload the page).
